displayDescription: A glass capsule shell opens a shallow component view and a cartridge joins at its seat, lighting one live link in the idea's network.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.187.0 (WebGL, MeshPhysicalMaterial, custom GLSL fresnel + reflection-strip shaders), bundled locally to scene.bundle.js with esbuild
motionEngine: GSAP 3 (local gsap.min.js) — one paused timeline at window.__timelines.video
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration. The seat contact at 2.05s is where a single mechanical contact cue would go if sound were enabled.
limitations: Glass is approximated: transparent clearcoat MeshPhysicalMaterial layers plus a fresnel silhouette shader and controlled additive reflection strips; no physical refraction/transmission or caustics.
Studio lighting uses a procedural RoomEnvironment PMREM map and two directional lights, not a captured HDRI.

STYLE.json contains no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview demonstrates the catalogue's characteristic action (broad reflection sweep, shallow component view, join at an obvious seat).
Blender was not used, per user instruction; the scene is procedural Three.js geometry.
Typography uses system Helvetica Neue/Arial; the 200 weight may fall back to a regular weight where unavailable.
